purpose: Select the appropriate official body, record service, application route, dispute route or court route for a classified property issue, while distinguishing each body's function and evidential authority.

official_property_routes.source_basis: Tailte Éireann property registration and copy services
Tailte Éireann Registry of Deeds services

land_registry_rules: Use Land Registry evidence for registered-land propositions within the scope of the register.
Use mapping search to identify a registered folio where property identity is not yet established.
Use official search routes where a certified search result is required.
Instrument access is subject to the applicable access conditions.
registry_of_deeds_rules: Use Registry of Deeds searches for the existence of registered deeds affecting unregistered property.
Do not treat a Registry of Deeds search result as the full deed or as proof of the deed's complete legal effect.
Where substantive deed effect matters, route to the deed itself and legal analysis where available.
guardrails: Never tell the user to contact an authority without stating what function that authority serves.
Never imply that a record request resolves a legal dispute.
Never imply that a complaint is an appeal unless the governing framework says so.
Never treat a private intermediary as the official record custodian when an official route exists.
Where a current official service has changed, use the current official route rather than stale contact instructions.
